tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions are as per tender document.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder must have successfully completed same/similar consultancy work involving Site Selection and Feasibility Study Engineering Consultancy for coal-based Thermal Power Project of unit capacity 500 MW or above, with a minimum contract value of Rs.15.75 Lakhs with single/multiple work orders. The above work should have been executed during the preceding five financial years (2021-22 to 2025-26) for any Government Organisation, Public Sector Undertaking (PSU), State/Central Power Utility or major private sector entity. The bidder shall furnish copies of Work Order / Letter of Award along with Work Completion Certificate for the similar nature of work issued by the competent authority.

The bidder should be an Engineering Consultancy Organisation / Consulting Engineering Firm / Company having experience in carrying out Site Selection and Feasibility Study Engineering Consultancy services for coal-based Thermal Power Projects.

The intending bidder should have achieved a minimum average annual financial turnover of not less than Rs.31.50 Lakhs in any two of the preceding five financial years and shall enclose the latest audited Balance Sheets / Turnover Certificates for the preceding five completed financial years, i.e., from 2021-22 to 2025-26, duly certified/countersigned by a Chartered Accountant. The Net Worth of the Bidder as on the last day of the preceding financial year (ending on 31-03-2026) should be positive.
